title: ContinuityState
description: Canonical state schema for the Division of Continuity Management. All variables defined here map directly to the ContinuityState GDScript singleton.

player_state.description: Persists across days. Saved on every case completion and every day end.

dissolution_index.description: How much of the Processor's identity has been successfully filed into the system. Primary progression meter. Higher = more assimilated.

thresholds.30.0: Subtle geometry increase in UI. Background patterns become more prominent.
thresholds.50.0: Player portrait begins shifting. System voice grows more intimate.
thresholds.70.0: Self-referential cases start appearing in queue. Text occasionally rewrites itself.
thresholds.90.0: Full assimilation path locked in. Reality bleeds into the forms.

efficiency_score.description: How well the Processor serves the Division. Determines case quality outcomes and performance evaluations.

continuity_contribution.description: Cumulative measurable impact on reality stability. Rises with every case completion.

clearance_level.description: Unlocks deeper form fields, more dangerous case types, and self-editing options. Increases at day transitions.

level_gates.1: Standard form fields. Basic case types.
level_gates.2: Symbol insertion field unlocked. Return cases visible. Mercy Override available.
level_gates.3: Self-surgery on Player File. Advanced self-referential audits. Dream Intervention.
level_gates.4: Cross-day ripple editing. Echo case variants.
level_gates.5: Temporal forms. Archive of Unraveling Cases access.

mythic_residue.description: Archetypal weight the Processor still carries. High values push toward Mythic Ascension or Anomaly status.

narrative_stability.description: How coherent the Processor's personal story remains. Dropping below 40 risks Unraveling events.

emotional_surplus.description: Unprocessed feelings leaking from the Processor's own file. Negative = deficit. Positive = surplus. Extreme values in either direction cause instability.

flags.description: Boolean event flags. Once set, most are permanent. Drive branching and ending paths.

grief_handling_style.description: Dominant pattern in how the Processor handles grief cases.

childhood_policy.description: Dominant policy toward childhood memory cases.

narrative_control.description: How tightly the Processor enforces approved narratives.

self_treatment.description: How the Processor relates to their own dissolving file.

echo_interactions.description: Count of meaningful interactions with Echo Fragment cases.

player_portrait_stage.description: Visual stage of portrait evolution. Calculated from dissolution_index. Stage 0 = human. Stage 5 = pure geometric sigil.

unraveling_risk.description: Composite risk of a major unraveling event. Calculated from dissolution, department_strain, unraveling_events, and reality_stability.

world_state.description: Global variables representing the health and mood of consensus reality. Affected by case decisions, ripple resolution, and player path.

reality_stability.description: Overall health of consensus reality. Below 40 triggers mass unraveling events.

department_strain.description: How overloaded the Division is. High strain triggers difficult or contradictory cases.

unraveling_events.description: Cumulative count of major anomalies triggered. Feeds unraveling_risk and System Fracture ending.

mythic_commodities_index.description: Supply of usable archetypes in circulation. Below 50 creates scarcity events. Above 150 risks archetype overflow.

collective_nostalgia.description: Cultural mood variable. Affects tone of greeting messages and available case types.

era.description: Current story act. Determines available case pool and world-state flavor text.

session_state.description: Transient variables tracking the current working day. Partially carries over between days.

current_day.description: Current day number. Drives case pool selection and clearance level updates.

daily_cases_processed.description: Cases completed in the current shift.

daily_efficiency.description: Temporary efficiency accumulator for today's performance review.

active_case_id.description: ID of the currently open case form. Empty string when none active.

pending_ripples.description: Queue of ripple effects to be resolved at end-of-day. Each entry is a ripple dict with type, text, and delayed_effects.

completed_cases.description: List of case IDs completed across all days. Used to prevent re-queuing and enable return cases.

ripple_system.description: Ripple effects are queued during case processing and resolved at end-of-day.

type.description: small = flavor text only. medium = flavor text + variable modification. major = triggers special events or ending branch shifts.

ripple_schema.text: string — narrative description of the ripple effect shown on End-of-Day screen.
ripple_schema.delayed_effects: Dictionary — stat modifications applied when this ripple resolves.
ripple_schema.unlocks_case: optional string — case ID unlocked by this ripple.
ripple_schema.ending_flag: optional string — flag contributing to an ending path.

ending_conditions.description: Evaluated at final case completion or explicit game-over state.
